label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler Leads TOUR Championship
items.text: Scottie Scheffler finished the TOUR Championship at 16-under, three shots ahead of Viktor Hovland at -13 and Ryan Gerard at -12.

items.headline: Chacarra Tops Race to Dubai
items.text: Eugenio Chacarra leads the DP World India Championship by two strokes, claiming the Race to Dubai lead over Patrick Reed and Rory McIlroy.

items.headline: Nicklaus Warned on Ball Distance
items.text: Before the 2001 Masters, Jack Nicklaus called modern golf ball distance "absurd" and warned it was ruining classic course design, prompting Augusta National to plan major course changes.
